q1: SELECT beer.name, min_price, bar FROM beer LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT beer, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM serves GROUP BY beer) AS t ON beer.name = t.beer LEFT OUTER JOIN serves ON beer.name = serves.beer AND min_price = serves.price
q2: SELECT b.name AS beer, MIN(s.price) AS price, s.bar FROM beer AS b LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.beer LEFT JOIN (SELECT beer, MIN(price) AS lowest_price FROM serves GROUP BY beer) AS lp ON b.name = lp.beer AND s.price = lp.lowest_price GROUP BY b.name, s.bar ORDER BY b.name, s.bar
